name: infinity-instruct-7M_mixed_sit_72k
description: infinity-instruct-7M_mixed_sit_72k is an instruction-tuning dataset composed of mixed instruction–response pairs intended to train or evaluate instruction-following models. It contains a variety of short tasks and prompts aimed at improving general-purpose conversational and instruction-following behaviors. The dataset is intended for supervised fine-tuning rather than as a held-out test benchmark.
evaluation_method: human_eval (or downstream task performance after fine-tuning)
reputation: A hosted Hugging Face dataset with limited but growing use for instruction tuning; not a widely standardized benchmark.
